title: itembank lesson-run session file
description: The paced-lesson session document written by runtime.start_lesson_run and updated by lesson_run_advance and lesson_run_record (plan 16D-02, D-PACED-2). A lesson run is a distinct session KIND, never a sitting: it carries no blueprint, no form, and no cursor over selected items. Position ('step') is presentation state: it is resumable and it never counts as coverage, mastery, or progress, and no consumer may read it as any of those. The durable attempt records are the response events in the one evidence store (context 'lesson_run'); the 'attempts' list here is gating and tier bookkeeping only.

bank.description: Absolute path of the bank whose lesson this run paces

step.description: The current step id, always a member of 'steps'; a recorded id the lesson no longer carries falls back to the first step at read time, never to a guessed neighbour

steps.description: The step ids model.lesson_steps resolved, in document order, at run creation

state.description: Gating state only: a step gates on attempted, never on correct (IL-20260828-03), so every one of these values opens the gate

attempt.description: The ordinal of this attempt for this item within this run

tier.description: The disclosure tier the runtime released for this attempt (D-PACED-3); tier 2 rides with tier 1

answer.description: The submitted answer, kept so the post-redirect re-render can recompute the runtime's tier disclosure for the same attempt; learner scratch state, never a second evidence record (the response event is the durable attempt)
